blind.why: Round-length histogram. The ref has a natural spread from 25 to 150 s, with long post-plant retakes and quick fragfests. Ours (18 real bot rounds) is boxed into 40-110 s with a mean of 72 s, and no round runs past the fuse because retakes never happen.
Eliminations per round. Near coin-flip: the means are almost the same (6.8 vs 6.9). Ours is flat from 5 to 9 with no low-tag save or retake rounds, so there is less variety.

Outcome mix. Ours: attackers win 67%, 0% of rounds end on time, 6% end on a defuse, and 11 of 12 plants are converted. The ref is roughly 48% attacker wins, with time-outs and defuses as real outcomes.

biggest_gap: Every real match ends in a soft-lock. When flow enters matchEnd, the menu's showEnd calls buildEnd, which falls back to A.econLog() because the match:end data has no econLog. That throws 'ReferenceError: econLog is not defined' (src/ui/menu/index.js:56). The end screen is never built, and 6 s later menu.state is still 'game' with phase 'matchEnd' forever. Repro: ?test=1&seed=6&match=1&phase=live, skip rounds to the end (shots/critic-flow/edge/edge2.json end2, matchend.png). The player is left on the in-game scoreboard with no MVP, end card or return path. CS2 goes straight to the match-end scoreboard/MVP screen and back to the lobby. Fix the undefined econLog, or have flow put a per-round econ log in match:end and the menu guard against it missing, then add a full-match end test.
other_gaps: Exit frags are still impossible in the real game. The tagger piece removed 'roundEnd' from SCORE_PHASES (src/combat/core.js:9), so ctx.combat.applyTag returns null during roundEnd (victim stays at 100 hp, killer gets +0, edge.json 'exit'). Flow's round-2 exit-frag pay/resync is dead code. CS2 allows and pays exit frags. Put roundEnd back for combat, or make flow and combat agree on one source of truth.

A Beacon dropped in mid-air floats forever. drop() snaps with a 4 m raycast from y+0.6. If the carrier is tagged 7 m above site A, the Beacon stays at y=8.5 for 40 s+, and no Ember can pick it up because pickup requires |dy|<=1.6 (edge.json air0-4). Any carrier tagged while falling off the catwalk or terrace loses the round's objective. Drop it onto the ground or navmesh with an unbounded ray and fall.

Pacing and balance with real bots (2 full matches, 18 rounds): attackers win 12/18, both matches end 8-1 after 9 rounds, first-half Ember goes 12-2, 11 of 12 plants win (CS2 post-plant is about 70%), 0 time-outs. Retakes are hopeless: in 4v1 and 3v1 fuse wins the lone defender never touches the beacon. Re-tune fuse/disarm/timer together with the bots' retake logic.

Overtime HUD desync: at 11-9 after OT the scoreboard header reads 'ROUND 20 · SECOND HALF · FIRST TO 8' and the top bar 'ROUND 20 / 15' (edge/matchend.png). It should say OVERTIME 1, first to 11 (otTarget).
The 'clutch' announce fires in 18/18 rounds, including 1v5 for a doomed last player. It is voice noise, and CS2 has no such call. Gate it on a winnable 1v1 or 1v2, or drop it.

The 9000 cap fills after 3 straight wins (round 4, the whole winning team at or near 9000). With CS2 prices, the winning side's later round income is mostly wasted and the money stops creating decisions.
Each spectate switch emits the 'spectate' event 2-3 times on the same tick (log ev). Listeners such as UI and audio fire repeatedly.
bugs: Match end: ReferenceError econLog at src/ui/menu/index.js:56. The end screen never appears and the match stays in matchEnd with no exit (cross-piece: flow match:end payload + menu)
Exit frags are blocked by combat SCORE_PHASES, contradicting flow's round-2 exit-frag rule
Beacon tagged-out in mid-air (>3.4 m above the floor) stays floating and can't be picked up, so the objective is soft-locked for the round
OT scoreboard/top bar shows 'FIRST TO 8 / ROUND 20/15 / SECOND HALF' during overtime
strengths: Economy rules now match CS2 in real play: the pistol loser gets 1900, the ladder runs 1900-3400 with a -1 decrement on a win, time-out Ember survivors get 0 (unit test), +800 plant-loss, +300 plant/disarm, and kill rewards follow class
Phase timers are exact over 18 live bot rounds (18 s pre-round, 105 s live, 35 s fuse), and JS heap stays flat at 108-135 MB across a match
Halftime swaps sides, scores, HUD and credits correctly. OT gives 5000, target 11, and swaps sides at the 3-round OT half. Quit-and-restart leaves no stale state
Spectate auto-follows the next living teammate and the HUD shows it; pause freezes the roundEnd timer; a ground-level dropped beacon is recovered by bots within 5 s
Information calls (match_point, last_round_of_half, beacon_dropped/picked_up, beacon_10/5, time_30) fire at the right moments
